text:
Alex Tan: Hey folks, day 2 here. SSO is fine but when I navigate to Console -> Admin -> Feature Flags I get a 403. I can see the Console home. Need staging admin to demo flag rollout.
Priya S.: welcome Alex! :tada: Sounds like a team-mapping issue. Which team did you sign up under?
Alex Tan: `platform-infra` and requested staging only.
OpsBot: Access tip -> open #access-requests and use the 'Console: staging-admin' template or 'SSH/KMS (staging)' if you need infra creds. Typical SLA: 8-24h for staging.
Marco: Alex, quick workaround: request a scoped session (2h) and we can demo from a jumpbox while infra patches your mapping. DM me the request id once filed.
Alex Tan: filed REQ-7112 (env=staging, team=platform-infra, reason=private-deploy demo 03/29 14:00-16:00 UTC) and attached screenshot of 403.
Priya S.: I updated REQ-7112 to include the SCIM team tag so the provisioner picks it up. Should be routed to infra today.
Tasha: If it still 403s after approval, try clearing cookies / open an incognito window — SSO claims sometimes need a refresh.
Alex Tan: great, pasted SSH pubkey in infra portal too. Will DM Marco for the jumpbox if needed. Thanks all! :smile:
